pins.head: GO UP, NOT ACROSS
pins.title: Small Apartment Storage That Does Not Eat the Floor Space
pins.desc: Wide furniture is what makes a small room feel full. A narrow ladder shelf holds the same books and baskets as a sideboard while touching almost none of the floor, and it costs less than the sideboard did. Contains affiliate links. #SmallApartment #BudgetStorage #ApartmentLiving
pins.alt: A ladder bookcase holding books and woven baskets beside a pale sofa with a fabric storage ottoman.

pins.head: BIG PATCHES WASTE THE SHEET
pins.sub: Match the Patch to the Spot
pins.title: Acne Patches: Oversized Ones Are the Ones You Waste
pins.desc: A patch much larger than the spot still costs a full patch, and the sheet runs out twice as fast. Work out which sizes you actually reach for, then price the box by those patches rather than by the total count. Contains affiliate links. #SkincareRefills #AcnePatches #PersonalCare
pins.alt: Sheets of round clear hydrocolloid patches in several sizes lying on a white bathroom counter above a light wood drawer.

pins.head: WHEELS INSTEAD OF WALLS
pins.title: A Slim Rolling Cart Is the Bathroom Cabinet You Can Move
pins.desc: A fitted cabinet needs wall, floor and permission. A slim cart needs none of the three: it slides into the gap beside the vanity, rolls out when you want what is at the back, and leaves with you. Contains affiliate links. #BathroomStorage #RollingCart #SmallBathroom
pins.alt: A slim white rolling cart standing beside a wooden vanity with a sink, soap bottles and a potted plant.

pins.head: A BRAYER PRESSES IT FLAT
pins.title: Cutting Mats: Use a Brayer So the Material Sits Flat
pins.desc: Material pressed down by hand keeps small air pockets, and the blade lifts exactly there. Rolling a brayer over the sheet puts even pressure across the whole mat, which is also what stops the mat wearing out in patches. Contains affiliate links. #CuttingMats #VinylCrafts #CraftTools
pins.alt: A flat stack of green, blue and purple cutting mats on a wooden table with a roller brayer and a cream scraper on top.

pins.head: BUY THE OUNCES YOU POUR
pins.sub: A Clear Kit Sized for Real Work
pins.title: Crystal Clear Epoxy Resin Kit, 34 oz of Resin and Hardener
pins.desc: Small trial kits run out mid-project and large drums go off before you reach the bottom. A thirty-four ounce kit covers a run of coasters or a tray without either problem, and the mix ratio stays the same as the small one. Contains affiliate links. #EpoxyResin #ResinCrafts #ResinSupplies
pins.alt: Two bottles of resin and hardener beside several clear graduated measuring cups and a notepad on a wooden table.

pins.head: A RISER FREES THE DESKTOP
pins.title: Small Desk: A Laptop Riser Gives You the Surface Back
pins.desc: The laptop footprint is the largest single thing on a small desk. Lifting it onto a stand turns that footprint into storage underneath, and the screen ends up at a height your neck prefers anyway. Contains affiliate links. #HomeOffice #DeskSetup #WorkFromHome
pins.alt: A light wood desk against a bright window with a laptop on a wooden stand, a lamp and a potted plant on the sill, with a teal chair pulled up to it.

pins.head: SQUEEZE SMALL, MIX MORE
pins.title: Acrylic Starter Palette: Small Dabs, Mixed Colours
pins.desc: Most of a beginner palette dries on the palette rather than going on the work. Put out dabs the size of a pea and mix what you need from them, and a starter set covers months instead of weeks. Contains affiliate links. #AcrylicPainting #ColorMixing #PaintingBasics
pins.alt: A white divided palette with small dabs of color, a row of brushes and a glass jar on a pine table, with paint tubes standing behind.

pins.head: BASKETS TAKE THE TOP SHELF
pins.title: Tiny Closet: Put the Off-Season Things on the Top Shelf
pins.desc: The shelf above the rail is awkward to reach, which makes it the right home for what you touch twice a year. Woven baskets keep it from becoming a loose pile, and you lift one basket instead of rummaging overhead. Contains affiliate links. #ClosetOrganization #SmallCloset #RenterFriendly
pins.alt: An open closet with clothes on a rail, woven baskets on the top shelf and clear shoe boxes on the floor.

pins.head: A DIVIDER KEEPS THEM UPRIGHT
pins.title: Toothpaste Multipacks: Store Them Standing, Not Stacked
pins.desc: A multipack laid flat in a drawer becomes a layer you dig through. Stood upright in a clear divider the whole stock is visible at a glance, so the reorder happens when the row thins rather than when the last tube runs out. Contains affiliate links. #BathroomDrawer #HouseholdStock #DentalCare
pins.alt: White toothpaste tubes standing upright in a clear divider inside an open wooden drawer.

pins.head: USE THE BACK OF THE DOOR
pins.title: Renter Storage: The Back of the Door Is Unused Space
pins.desc: Every room has a door, and the face of it is usually the only vertical surface nobody has claimed. A pocket organizer hangs over the top edge, holds what would otherwise sit on a shelf, and leaves no fixings behind. Contains affiliate links. #RenterFriendly #NoDrillStorage #SmallSpaceHacks
pins.alt: A pocket organizer hanging on an open door beside a pale sofa with cushions and a fabric ottoman, with a tall shelf of plants by the window.

pins.head: A MONTH IN ONE BAG
pins.title: Colombia Medium Roast Whole Bean Coffee, 32 oz Bag
pins.desc: Two pounds of whole bean is roughly a month of a daily pot, which makes it the easy unit for a standing order. Buying the month in one bag also keeps the beans whole until the morning you grind them. Contains affiliate links. #WholeBeanCoffee #CoffeeAtHome #PantryRestock
pins.alt: Two plain kraft coffee bags beside a small blank desk calendar, a mug and scattered coffee beans on a light wood counter.

pins.head: BINS NEED A QUARTER INCH
pins.title: Kitchen Bins: Leave Clearance or the Set Will Not Fit
pins.desc: Cabinet openings are rarely square, and a bin cut to the exact interior width will catch on one side. Measure at the narrowest point, take a quarter inch off, and buy to that number rather than to the shelf width. Contains affiliate links. #KitchenStorage #PantryBins #SmallKitchen
pins.alt: An open cream kitchen cabinet with clear stackable drawers and jars, with a yellow tape measure on the shelf.
